company.name: Rampnalysis
company.shortDescription: Rampnalysis is a financial technology infrastructure company.
company.description:
Rampnalysis is a financial technology infrastructure company specializing in fiat-to-crypto and crypto-to-fiat transaction aggregation solutions. Founded in 2022 by Edozie Izegbu and headquartered in Dubai, the company provides developer-focused tools that simplify the integration of cryptocurrency purchasing and payment functionality into digital platforms.

Rather than operating as a direct fiat gateway or custodial wallet provider, Rampnalysis functions as an aggregation and analytics layer that connects users with third-party on-ramp and off-ramp providers. Its infrastructure enables businesses and developers to compare pricing, liquidity, regional availability, payment methods, and asset coverage across multiple crypto conversion services in real time.

The company’s core product offering includes SDKs, APIs, widgets, and integration tools that allow developers to embed crypto buying, selling, and payment functionality into mobile applications, websites, marketplaces, gaming platforms, and NFT ecosystems. Rampnalysis also supports operational elements such as KYC workflows, regulatory compliance coordination, payment optimization, and transaction routing through integrated service providers.
